preconditions.description: The number of servers n is between 3 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of connections m is between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.
The index of the critical server v is between 1 and n inclusive.
There are at least 3 servers, ensuring at least two other servers exist besides v.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to satisfy the constraints (m is too small to connect the graph or too large to avoid making v non-critical), output -1.
If a solution exists, exactly m lines of connections are output.

postconditions.expression: not impossible_condition and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= w <= n and u != w for u, w in edges)
postconditions.description: Every output connection links two distinct valid server indices.
All output connections are unique (no duplicate pairs).
The set of connections forms a connected graph where all n servers are reachable from each other.

postconditions.expression: not impossible_condition and not is_connected([e for e in edges if e[0] != v and e[1] != v], n)
postconditions.description: Removing server v (and all its incident edges) disconnects the graph, making transmission between some pair of remaining servers impossible.
